title: Explicit Attack, soft-cover line of fire and detour decisions
scope: Static game-binary research. A structural pass is insufficient to approve a hook, predict a live shot, or establish multiplayer agreement.

authority.admit: Serial simulation actor/order invocation, exact concrete human or vehicle host brain, !remote, emission role, explicit Attack provenance, same owner and target. Honor control, hold and inhibition. Reacquire objects per trial.

attack.status: Scoped insertion point identified. A clear result continues Attack scheduling and readiness.

layout.+4: f32 cumulative distance in trajectory output

stock_verdicts.3: target entity or path proximity, subject to allied scan
stock_verdicts.5: trajectory blocked or earlier muzzle probe veto

line_of_fire.decision: Only the trajectory-derived 5 is eligible. Preserve the stock first verdict and source. Replay the sampled launch inputs in a separate collector. Require complete target and friendly/backstop coverage, independently reject hard/unknown contacts and HE proximity. Native all-hits excludes filtered objects and ends on terminal terrain/water.

ballistics.detonation_thickness: eStuffBullet token 0x2e -> ammo+0x12b8, typed kind 0. Live 0x84c143..0x84c175 compares consumed contact energy and this threshold in kind 6.
ballistics.blast_bound: 0x7f5870 returns [ammo+0x498] if positive. Inspect every descriptor in [ammo+0x480,ammo+0x488) and include each recognized outer radius. Unknown effects keep veto.

reposition.abi: RCX=caller context, RDX=initialized caller result, XMM2=world radius, AL=success
reposition.explicit_vehicle: 0x903698; preserve parent and retry. Stock nonhuman obstruction uses eLookAt only in aimer state 7.
reposition.autonomous_vehicle: 0x9af4d3 consumes due brain+0x3d8. Root Move installation replaces the current order.
reposition.private_candidate_design: Use copied actor, target and geometry state and private tie-breaker. No repeated pose solves, shooter sampling, vehicle route probes or native circle sampling. Rank validated lateral/corner points against committed hostile observations. Defer final aim and route admission to the ordinary order.

replication.move: eMoveTask point factory 0x90a8c0 -> path Move 0x90a7b0 -> eMove execution +0x3c gate -> ID 0x09
replication.fire: 0x905240 -> 0x8eb9c0 -> 0x8ecbf0 -> native target commit ID 0x0c. SyncedProjectiles has separate conditional ID 0x0e.
replication.ownership: 0x91a180 replaces the parent child. Infantry appends move/cover and wait-ready using 0x919270. Re-evaluate after child completion.
